description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Avenging Angel.
When Avenging Angel dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Avenging Angel's power, ultimately milling Avenging Angel.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting Avenging Angel from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
